name: Tapestry
description: Tapestry owns two fashion brands, Coach and kate spade new york, and makes money by selling their handbags, small leather goods, footwear and apparel, about 87 percent of it through its own stores, outlets and websites and the rest to wholesale partners and licensees. Coach is the engine: it was 86.4 percent of FY2026 sales and earned $2.54 billion of segment profit while Kate Spade roughly broke even. Products are made by independent factories (mainly Vietnam, Cambodia, the Philippines, India). Sales were $8.0 billion in FY2026 (+14.2%) with a 77.8 percent gross margin and 23.9 percent operating margin. Stuart Weitzman was sold on 2025-08-04.
